snippet.title: "In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect" Now Available!
snippet.description:
"In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect" officially launches on G123!

An isekai idle RPG based on the anime "In Another World with My Smartphone: 2!" Enjoy casual growth and battles as you go on an adventure in another world with the heroines!

Play Now: https://s.g123.jp/a2co616n

This is an HTML5 game playable on web browsers of smartphones, tablets, or PC. No downloads required—enjoy different playstyles, from taking your time on PC at home to quick sessions on your smartphone while out and about.

■Voice
Touya Mochizuki: Katsumi Fukuhara
Leen: Sumire Uesaka

■ Game Info
Game Title: In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect
Genre: Idle Battle RPG
Price: Free to play (in-game purchases available)
Supported Languages (planned): Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean

#IseConnect #ISESUMA #G123 #FreeGame #NewGame #IdleRPG
